name: VRM_PRICE_BASIS_DATA_SETS
description: VRM_PRICE_BASIS_DATA_SETS contains VSOE price basis data sets. The source documents are grouped into the VSOE price basis data sets using a fair market value template, currency, and extraction period.

columns.name: PRICE_BASIS_DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a VSOE price basis data set.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: TOTAL_REVENUE_AMOUNT

columns.name: TOTAL_REVENUE_LINES_COUNT

columns.name: LINES_REQUIRING_ATTENTION

columns.name: AMOUNT_REQUIRING_ATTENTION
columns.description: Total amount requiring attention of a price basis data set.

columns.name: LINES_PENDING_REVIEW
columns.description: Number of excluded VSOE price basis lines pending for review.

columns.name: AMOUNT_PENDING_REVIEW
columns.description: Line amount of a pending review line.

columns.name: LINES_REVIEWED
columns.description: Number of excluded VSOE price basis lines that were reviewed by a revenue analyst or manager already.

columns.name: AMOUNT_REVIEWED
columns.description: Total amount of reviewed excluded lines of a price basis data set.

columns.name: LINES_READY_FOR_PRICE_CALC
columns.description: Number of VSOE price basis lines ready for VSOE price calculation.

columns.name: AMOUNT_READY_FOR_PRICE_CALC
columns.description: Line amount of a requiring attention line.

columns.name: LINES_PROCESSED
columns.description: Number of processed VSOE price basis lines.

columns.name: AMOUNT_PROCESSED
columns.description: Line amount of a processed line.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
